12:T3e166,<p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-63058f2a-ce96-4cd9-b5b5-91a4ba74c5d0" style="">기아 타이거즈가 6경기를 남긴 가운데</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-61f5064f-fb56-474f-bf64-1d4a48829cf4" style="">김도영 선수의 40홈런 40도루 기록 달성이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-c4fb7aae-2490-4fe8-861d-490c5583f23d" style="">가능할지가 초미의 관심사입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f8032181-1fa3-4a7e-ae0c-922e9db090c1" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-760e27f8-79c5-489a-bbf7-4766110cc969" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://m.khan.co.kr/sports/baseball/article/201510022241095" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                        alt="경향신문"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://m.khan.co.kr/sports/baseball/article/201510022241095" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        경향신문
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        경향신문은 사원이 주인입니다. 권력과 자본에 속박되지 않고 독자가 궁금해하는 뉴스를 진실되게 전달합니다.
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-610f81ec-82d9-4c3e-9497-8fcf8bfbbcfa" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-956ff1e8-b6a5-4c61-b885-80e4082c480a" style="">프로야구 유일무이의 대기록인 40-40은</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d311b5d5-f7c5-42a3-a9f3-4bad731018a2" style="">2015년 에릭 테임즈 선수가 기록한 바 있는데요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ec40fb57-b8e1-4ac6-8a7c-cecaf3e39918" style="">테임즈는 먼저 홈런을 채워놓고</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-979e7c73-162a-423b-b0a7-17c94faf2f18" style="">40도루를 완성하면서 기록을 달성한 반면</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-19a999f6-284e-4907-b46a-558a6d917c5e" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9205e2bc-cd0d-4b45-9d6e-6319086bb922" style="">
                <div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 10px; max-width: 600px;">
                  
                    <a href="https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/sports/baseball/1153896.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <img
                        src="data:image/webp;base64,"
                        alt="스무살 김도영, 30홈런-30도루…KBO리그 새 역사 쓰다"
                        style="width: 100%; object-fit: cover; margin-bottom: 10px;"
                      />
                    </a>
                  
                  <div>
                    <a href="https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/sports/baseball/1153896.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                      <div style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        스무살 김도영, 30홈런-30도루…KBO리그 새 역사 쓰다
                      </div>
                      <div style="font-size: 0.875rem; color: #555;">
                        15일 서울 고척 스카이돔에서 열린 기아(KIA) 타이거즈와 키움 히어로즈의 경기. 1회초 1사 1루에서 김도영(KIA)은 상대 선발 엔마누엘 헤이수스의 3구째 슬라이더를 공략해 큼지막한 타구를 날렸다. 하지만 타구는 왼쪽 폴대를 살짝 비껴갔다. 파울 홈런 뒤 아쉬움을
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-15cc4639-7513-4994-b3ff-a1ecbec82cea" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-77bb298c-0bea-4967-ad60-62ad47cbfe85" style="">김도영은 홈런과 도루 모두</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-359a2dc0-1ce0-41b3-adf0-8733949fc995" style="">기록해야 한다는 점에서 더 어려운 과제임이</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f5ba5a12-67bb-45ab-a210-2acd7abdab06" style="">분명해 보입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-01242761-1049-4f4d-ad46-eb9dac71df82" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223589188715_0.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-67416c03-c66f-4c1f-8565-2510d8fef053" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ad513fea-8abf-412b-8231-87e28caf5b0e" style="">홈런은 3개, 도루는 1개를 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2bdd614f-431f-4c33-850d-556d4befef20" style="">더 기록해야 하는데요...</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a5cd7b03-98a2-4b7e-8a96-ff82bf06bcf6" style="">애초에 도루는 더 많이 할 수 있음에도</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a99e33ab-5ad3-410e-82f5-b537b68602a4" style="">부상 위험 등으로 인해서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-3b314ca3-68e7-420a-955e-99763609f15b" style="">40개 정도를 목표로 한다고 해왔기에</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a88cde4a-f9fe-4b2d-8f80-69cc9b672c39" style="">출루만 한다면 쉽게 가능할 것 같지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-8340e925-1d11-40c8-8476-fba921f0b197" style="">문제는 홈런입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a2611045-b2ec-4da0-b6b4-acd900109ece" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223589188715_1.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f5b96c9b-97e6-4e0b-96b8-8d21fac9fce1" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a560b856-4772-4be1-83bd-687c688b058d" style="">그렇다면 앞으로 남은 일정을 기반으로</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-11c5e51e-d967-4901-b633-b053d9914ca9" style="">40-40의 가능성을 한 번 예측해 보겠습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-402f5893-14c3-4671-bf80-2cba65961cad" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223589188715_2.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-1ba1ecd6-47ca-4a02-b9d5-edac94f7be42" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs24 se-ff-" id="SE-b13aff4d-a1c2-4ffe-9c1a-8a3c0b4c5403" style="color:#ba0000;"><u><b>구장에 따른 계산</b></u></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-04bc8787-8606-4ae7-b7af-94f59bb064e3" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-24ca4553-5b09-4d7d-aa07-02959ba453ff" style="">우승 확정 이후 1번으로 출장 시키겠다는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-8af07fcf-72ac-42b2-9999-50dec75b59ef" style="">이범호 감독의 인터뷰가 있었죠.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-6fb84fb5-55b9-4ae1-b5a4-79e1056c3d5f" style="">그러므로 넉넉하게 1게임당 5회 타석에</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-27ecacac-f016-47db-a085-b2b95ef7655e" style="">들어선다고 가정하고 계산해 봤습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs11 se-ff-" id="SE-292cb71f-433c-49dd-a798-2e5200fe48f5" style="color:#5bc7ff;">물론 팀이 이기면 9회말이 없어서 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs11 se-ff-" id="SE-8639ec63-8788-4c9e-bdf0-6ac155a53c92" style="color:#5bc7ff;">5회타석이 어렵긴 합니다</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs11 se-ff-" id="SE-e60d8084-92ff-411f-b3c8-5395dcde318e" style="">​</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">구장</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">타석당 홈런수</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">예상수</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">챔피언스 필드</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.054</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">1.08</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">이글스 파크</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.125</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.625</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">사직야구장</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.034</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.17</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-70c42268-e0b5-43e9-89ef-2e73ae04ef7e" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d8c80f5d-04c4-4ac5-b645-6233bc086667" style="">구장으로만 보면 가능성이 낮습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-1c144db4-bec2-4e05-a81b-91d904cf1208" style="">특히 원정보다 홈에서 더 못 쳤었는데</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-155af990-2d7e-465f-aa06-00e4246af0b7" style="">홈경기가 4경기나 남아 있다는 점</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-42f23562-ffdb-4968-a9eb-8ed46fd349c5" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223589188715_3.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-597fc2a8-202f-4eef-8257-271cbb3aa12a" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-473ffd45-96b4-49de-8d32-e63f61b2fb36" style="">홈런을 1개밖에 못 친 사직야구장에서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-22e6932b-c9d3-4b2c-92de-547233788e9b" style="">시즌 마지막 경기가 있다는 점은</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-d0580956-2509-4af9-a387-c8034229293f" style="">전망을 어둡게 하는 주요 이유입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0769c476-8aaf-4e63-9430-70ea981016eb" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs24 se-ff-" id="SE-ab100da2-8db7-4056-ae5d-e0d3f3156d92" style="color:#ba0000;"><u><b>상대 전적에 따른 계산</b></u></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-fc79ab85-f908-41af-be0f-0818b2e2f0c6" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-71e0d3ed-d2f2-41f9-b7e7-f7027c30a637" style="">이번에는 상대하는 팀에 따라서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-c186e04c-755b-4e20-a725-cc3bf9219386" style="">계산을 해보도록 하겠습니다.</span><br/></p>
<table class="m-4" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:80%;border:1px solid #ddd;"><thead style="background-color:#f9f9f9;"><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">구장</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">타석당 홈런수</th><th style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">예상수</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">NC</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.063</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.315</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">삼성</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.061</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.61</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">한화</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.115</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.575</td></tr><tr style="border:1px solid #ddd;"><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">롯데</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.048</td><td style="border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:center;">0.48</td></tr></tbody></table><p><span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-cb6eed11-24ba-4b12-8be3-2840adae9ac8" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-9ebde681-f900-45e9-b7d2-e9b29c3b7ae2" style="">상대 전적으로 따져도 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f701ed56-5ebf-4db3-a377-0c9c95893fc5" style="">가장 많은 홈런을 기록했던</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-4b00371e-61ca-48b8-a893-e2db981e4de9" style="">한화 이글스와의 경기가 1경기 밖에</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-381179bd-3c74-433a-af25-cb12653e7f2f" style="">남지 않았기 때문에 가능성이 높아 보이지</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a7182777-28c6-46bf-b11f-d9c79a58274a" style="">않습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-a848d73e-bc58-4895-af37-a64999874b1f" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs-fs24 se-ff-" id="SE-f618776e-db74-453d-9bbb-bfda727d8233" style="color:#ba0000;"><u><b>상대팀 상황에 따른 희망 회로</b></u></span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-1c78e15a-8773-47fd-928e-604f7b4cc8b2" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-30a6ba27-2470-48b9-bf93-9869ea30aa5e" style="">일단 삼성을 제외하고는 모두</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-40af2f13-1fa8-4bfe-9770-7899991be8cf" style="">시즌 순위가 크게 중요하지 않은 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-25e595c3-298c-4ee2-9b1f-d64f5f19db01" style="">팀들이라는 점은 희망적입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-beeb0b0a-1394-4ffb-9a56-da0bdf7c04f0" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223589188715_4.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-0279bbad-7305-4984-84a3-c394adb3494f" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-b5f566ab-aac5-43b8-aa72-5a00cdd1445e" style="">NC전 상대 선발이 </span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f00364fc-2e2f-41cf-bccb-5be1a4b52b17" style="">리그 에이스 모습을 보이고 있는</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-31da61f5-cf93-4899-a8a3-0fe008f8cd42" style="">하트가 아닐 것으로 보입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-73db350f-ec66-4daf-ad81-ba0b380bf7a7" style="">​</span><br/>
<img src="https://news.reddol18.pe.kr:29000/tigers-thumbnail/223589188715_5.png" alt="Alt text"><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f3095d4e-5588-4f56-9194-d6bfab2220b8" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-ed36f8f5-fc67-4d2d-8c03-0e3f08f6b23d" style="">삼성 또한 아직 2위 경쟁 중이지만</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-c4f38dde-3a78-4159-8742-19850c46b209" style="">9월 피홈런이 14개입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-5960bb59-3e4f-459f-81f1-e2d2ebc4480f" style="">마찬가지로 롯데 한화도 각각</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-bec677c1-3bb1-4cd8-95e5-7f5d9f62e1de" style="">15개, 17개로 9월 피홈런이 많습니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-f76cb485-493c-4242-b7b3-4c1e404e69f2" style="">과연 결과는 어떻게 될까요?</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-fc10c360-d744-4140-b0f2-4473a8ac999e" style="">달성한다면 부디 홈에서 달성해서</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-2ace9fb6-ea1f-48a5-bf91-12acdc7fe9db" style="">홈 팬들을 기쁘게 해주면 좋겠네요.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-61360cd4-976b-44d1-bd87-8c020089aa89" style="">달성하지 못해도 내년 시즌 동기부여를 위한</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-1c21df30-a9e0-41f0-adc3-4dbf96906be8" style="">새로운 목표가 될 테니</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-431b31fd-0316-4dc0-8b8f-fc5f688e69c2" style="">실망할 이유가 없어 보입니다.</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-29f0bdaf-c15f-4a81-ba75-d2da60cccf16" style="">​</span><br/>
<span class="se-fs- se-ff-" id="SE-615b01f8-5322-4d9f-b8a5-2241621f41bc" style="">​</span><br/></p>
